blurb: Guests cruise aboard iconic red and white vessels with expert narration and views of the Golden Gate Bridge, Alcatraz Island, and San Francisco's waterfront. Cruises range from one hour to 2.5 hours including whale watching and special event cruises. The company is family-owned since 1892 and committed to sustainability.
